title: Card maker settings
description: Everything about a card maker that the repository's tools need, in one file: maker/maker.json. The card's load file carries none of it. tools/maker/maker.py and tools/cardkit/gp/maker.ts (parseMaker) check a file against these rules; maker/README.md explains each field.

example.description: true only in the shared repository's neutral file. Tools that would write it to a card in the field (a release build of the provisioner) refuse an example file; tests and benches use it.

name.description: The card maker's name, 1 to 64 characters, no control characters, not only spaces, as tools show it, and as its rows in docs/CARD-DESIGNS.md name it.

tagAddress.description: The address the card's NFC tag carries, given in the tag's install parameters; the card adds #new or #<code>. The rules are spec/APDU.md's (The NFC tag) and spec/vectors/tag-address.json's.

securityDomain.description: null to install into the card manager (the issuer security domain). Otherwise the maker's own supplementary security domain, which installs and loads are made into.

aid.description: The domain's AID, upper-case hex, 5 to 16 bytes.

dapPublicKey.description: The public half of the maker's release key, upper-case hex, where the domain asks for a DAP signature on every load. Never the private key.

designCodes.description: The card-face design codes this maker registered in docs/CARD-DESIGNS.md (each a row whose 'whose' is this maker's name). Empty for none.
